[i]The last month has been a tough one for me, both mentally and physically, to say the least, but I've tried to work on the update as much as possible.
Those of you who have been following the project from the very beginning already know that I work on it alone, I do not have any funding and I develop it on my own, the only reason this project continues to live is my desire to give the world something something good and make people even a little happier. Sometimes there come moments when my mind is clouded by problems and sorrows, then I forget about my desire and aspiration, devaluing my own work, doubts come about my goals and the correctness of the chosen path. At such moments, I re-read your comments and reviews about this project, they help me remember that after all, I chose the right path. Your kind words keep the fire burning inside of me and encourage me to develop this project further, but with the depletion of resources, it becomes more and more difficult. Many of you know that item drops in the game are balanced so that the player does not need to buy them, and the purchase of items in the game itself would be just a way to support the project. By transferring the project to a free version, I wanted to give everyone the opportunity to access the game so that everyone could evaluate the project and become part of it. Unfortunately this was a mistake. After switching to the free version, I received some completely unconstructive negative feedback, and that significant increase in players did not have any positive effect in the community, as a result, this project became even more unprofitable.
I am sorry to inform you that I will again have to take up work on a side project and freeze the development of this project indefinitely, in order to form a budget for subsequent work on First Day.
I will still monitor possible bugs after this update and release a patch to fix them, but the release of subsequent updates is in doubt.
Due to all of the above, I decided to release [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1893250/First_Day__Supporter_Pack/?beta=0]DLC to support[/url] the project and speed up the release of new updates, this DLC will contain in itself exclusive sets of things that will change every few months. Thus, I hope to avoid long delays in the work on updates and at the same time thank everyone involved in the development of the project![/i]

Due to some unpleasant developments, work on this update did not go according to plan. The main problem was hard drive breakdown and loss of a lot of project data.

Also, a user showed up who received an exclusive set in a dishonest way.

[h3]ATTENTION!
Henceforth, any attempts to obtain game items by dishonest means will be tracked and suppressed! And the perpetrators will be punished![/h3]

Due to the disrupted plans and deadlines, I decided to release in this update what is already ready to give you the opportunity to adapt to some of the innovations that will be listed below.

[b]So what's new ?![/b]

Work on the Pioneer kit is complete!
(bonus kit for players who bought the game)
To receive the kit:
[olist]
[*] Download the game update.
[*] Download the special game add-on for old players.
[*] Check if your add-on is enabled in the game add-ons section of the incentive.
[*] Start the game!
[/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35068425/4c0800fcf2495ab1cd781698ca1282f58e5bf276.gif[/img]

The work on the location "Suicide Island" is completed!
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35068425/99bc45f65feedd4739c1f58398598c6acd445262.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35068425/39ddc5c33e813bb7b012d2282e200248b7acd4c0.png[/img][/url]
Moving across locations occurs through the global map.
To access the global map:
[olist]
[*] Find one of the green areas located at the edges of the location.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35068425/b912203761e92923f46d26d023d395686a2cc6e3.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35068425/6aca8113e84513df3d0becc0ea199ad75870ddbc.png[/img][/url]
[*] After clicking on the green area, in the pop-up window, form a detachment for travel by selecting several members of the group from among the survivors in your camp.
[*] After the group is formed, go on a journey by pressing the appropriate key.
[*] On the global map, select the desired location from the list of available ones. (at the moment there are 2 locations available, the starting location "Desert of Death" and the new location "Suicide Island")
[/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35068425/f02d1a4dbc100ff612e4c78d6677cc1a09728c4d.png[/img]

[b]Note![/b]
The ability to transport resources between game locations will appear only in the next update! At the moment, the system for changing locations does not provide for the transfer of resources! Therefore, when you first move to a new location, you will have at your disposal the basic amount of food.

The character stats are almost complete!
Now you can track the status of your characters and meet some of their needs!
Keep track of your survivors' hunger, thirst, fatigue and temperature levels! Don't let them drain and overheat, or you risk losing them!
At night, the temperature in the desert is much lower, so survivors who are not busy with work or occupy a guard post can freeze! To prevent your survivors from freezing, let them bask by the fire!
[b]Note![/b]
During the daytime, the temperature is extremely high, any work will overheat your survivors, and being around a fire or any other source of heat can cause critical overheating!
Other stats and character needs need to be tweaked and balanced, so they'll be available in the next updates!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35068425/1c2bbe1bc10367e580efa31d1468833cc726b313.jpg[/img]

The work on viruses is complete!
Now you can completely control the incidence and spread of viruses among your survivors!
However, more detailed information about viruses and the consequences of infection by them will be available in the update dedicated to viruses!
At the moment, there are 3 types of viruses available, all you need to know about them now, viruses are the most evil and dangerous of all your enemies in this world!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35068425/4dd64dc8a6373ca2fff5f8b85835c9af08a98064.jpg[/img]

New skill for survivors!
The "Wolf Stamina" skill has been unlocked, which increases your survivor's stamina!

Description of the characteristics of objects!
Now you can read about the characteristics of items in stock!
Lists of item characteristics will be updated in the next updates!

New shaders!
Now the appearance of game locations is even more attractive, and their loading is faster!

Extension of the LOD system!
An additional level of detail has been added to almost every game object, which should have a beneficial effect on the speed of the game on many devices!

I will be glad to receive your messages in game discussions!
Report bugs and suggest your ideas for what you would like to see in the next game updates!
Have a nice game! I'll go work on new locations and try to release the next update as soon as possible! Thank you for being with me!

notes.content:
Hello!
I did not have time to adapt to 2019, as the new 2020 came.
Time is ruthless. It rushes with a crazy speed towards the point at which death awaits.
However, let's not talk about sad things!
2019 was a difficult year for all of us, but despite all the difficulties of the past year, it was also very productive, even for me!
For 2019, I managed to bring "First Day" to early access, do a lot of work on updates, work with a beautiful young artist on a joint small project, and also start work on a new small project that will be announced in the near future!
In the festive bustle intertwined with workdays, I did not manage to pay due attention to the New Year update, and did not even make an announcement with the changes and innovations, and therefore I am correcting myself!
And so, what awaits us in the new version?

[b] Main events: [/b]
[list] [*] The beginning of the processing of the map and the study of new locations, including plot!
[*] Optimization! Thanks to winter magic, my magic drum and premature loading of shaders, as well as materials - the load on the processor and video card is reduced!
[*] Many old errors have been fixed, as well as new ones! (which I will naturally eliminate in the future)
[*] Cacti dressed up like Christmas trees!
[*] Mines shoot with fireworks!
[*] New exclusive bad Santa hat that you can try to get in daily boxes! (+31 health)
[*] Some changes to the interface and information windows. [/list]

[b] Summing up. [/b]
Yes, not a lot, but if you follow the forums and discussions of the game, then most likely you are already aware that at the moment my financial situation forces me to devote most of my working time to another project, which, as I mentioned above, will be announced in the near future, and in the event of a successful release of which, with double zeal and renewed vigor I will return to the hard work on "First Day"!
In conclusion, I want to say that whatever obstacles we encounter on our path of life, no matter how big and difficult they may seem to us, it is quite possible to overcome! The most important thing in moments of melancholy and despair is to pull yourself together, wipe away all snot and tears, tighten your fist, and continue to go to your goal!
Dear friends, I want to say a big thank you to all those who continue to support me, to all those who still play and are waiting for each update of my games, to all those who are interested and active in forums and discussions, to all those who offer their ideas for updates and communicate about the errors found! Thanks you! Without you, all this would not have happened! Each of your messages, comments, screenshots, videos, all this very motivates me to work and makes it clear that someone needs and is interested in what I do.
Thank you very much! And I wish you that in the new year all your dreams and desires come true, that happiness pursues you on the heels, that all adversities pass you by, and those that happen will temper and give new strength!
Love it! And be loved! Happy new year 2020!
